title: Restaurant Reservation Checklist
subtitle: Capture the guest request, time, party size, seating needs, waitlist status, and confirmation.
description: Coordinates one restaurant booking from guest contact through seating. It records the location, date and time, party size, seating preference, accessibility accommodation, occasion, waitlist position, confirmation, changes, and host receipt.
use_case: Use when reservation staff accept, change, waitlist, or confirm a table. The request is not confirmed until its status and reservation owner are recorded. Questions about applicable accessibility or service requirements go to the restaurant's authorized manager.

sections.title: Restaurant Reservation contact and reference
sections.guidance: Record guest name and contact, reservation date and time, party size, seating preference, accessibility need, occasion note, confirmation, waitlist position, and seating outcome.

sections.title: Restaurant Reservation exception review: checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current restaurant reservation facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Restaurant Reservation required checks
items: Reservation time is identified for this record
Party size matches the current request or source
Table need is ready for point-of-use staff
Occasion limits or questions are resolved
Waitlist is communicated to the responsible person
Seating acceptance is confirmed at handoff
A changed restaurant reservation fact is returned for review

blocks.label: Restaurant Reservation failed or pending items

sections.title: Restaurant Reservation readiness and handoff
sections.guidance: Hold restaurant reservation readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Restaurant Reservation reviewer receipt
blocks.guidance: Restaurant Reservation receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
